in_sanskrit.name: Akbal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal, Invincible
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Akbal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Akbal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ak’ (Immortal) and ‘Bal’ (Strength). This name is given to a child who is believed to possess immense power and strength that transcends the physical realm. In Hindu mythology, Akbal is the name of a powerful deity, Lord Shiva, who is revered for his invincibility and immortality.
